visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy in a red Ferrari-branded t-shirt stands in a modern kitchen/living area with a large black and white Mickey Mouse artwork on the wall behind him. He touches a large blue rectangular box on a white table. The lighting is bright and natural indoor light. (2) A woman with her hair in a high ponytail, wearing a beige tank top, enters the frame from the right carrying a young toddler girl. The girl is wearing a red t-shirt with a Mario print. They approach the blue box which has a record player design on the lid. (3) The woman and the girl interact with the blue box, moving a small blue plastic arm that resembles a phonograph needle. The girl smiles broadly while the woman guides her hands. The background shows a clean, upscale home environment with built-in appliances. (4) The woman lifts the lid of the box, revealing a circular mirror on the inner side and a pop-up display with graphics. A second young boy appears briefly in the background. The girl looks into the box with a focused and curious facial expression. (5) The woman pulls out several items from the box, including 'Baby Shark' stickers and a small yellow plastic shark toy. They handle the objects over the white table surface. The girl reaches for the toy with both hands while smiling excitedly. (6) The woman places a large, transparent blue plastic disc onto the top of the unit and inserts a smartphone into a designated slot. The girl watches closely as the woman demonstrates the functionality. They are positioned in a medium shot showing their upper bodies.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A boy's high-pitched voice expresses excitement followed by the start of a bright, major-key electronic pop BGM at a moderate volume. The room's background acoustic floor is very clean, resembling studio silence. (2) A friendly woman's voice begins a conversational narrative with high pitch variability. A stylized 'ding' sound effect is heard, coinciding with the touching of the blue box. The music beat is steady and uplifting. (3) A clear 'pop' sound effect occurs as the lid of the box is opened, followed by the woman's surprised vocal exclamation. Faint plastic and paper rustling noises are audible as toys are extracted. (4) The young girl's joyful vocalizations and laughter overlap with the woman's speech. The BGM maintains its upbeat tempo. Occasional soft percussive thuds of objects hitting the table provide acoustic depth. (5) A technical sliding sound effect is audible as the phone is placed into the unit. The woman's tone remains warm and encouraging. The BGM swells slightly as the video concludes with a mix of child and adult laughter.
